title: Bio Foot Reflexology and Massage

services.name: Massage
services.desc: At Bio Foot Reflexology and Massage Center, we offer a variety of professional massage services designed to promote relaxation, relieve tension, and support overall wellness. Our experienced therapists combine traditional and modern massage techniques to create a personalized treatment experience tailored to your individual needs. Whether you are seeking the therapeutic benefits of Tui Na Massage, the focused pressure of Deep Tissue Massage, the relaxing strokes of Swedish Massage, or the soothing warmth of Hot Stone Massage, we are committed to helping you feel your best. Serving clients throughout Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Hillsboro, Tigard, Tualatin, Portland, and surrounding communities.

services.name: Facial
services.desc: At Bio Foot Massage, our Chinese Facial Massage combines traditional Chinese massage techniques and facial acupressure to help improve circulation, reduce tension, and promote a healthy, radiant appearance. This relaxing treatment encourages blood flow to the face while helping to release stress held in the facial muscles, jaw, neck, and scalp. Unlike invasive cosmetic procedures, Chinese Facial Massage works with the body’s natural processes to support healthy skin and overall wellness. Chinese Facial Massage is a traditional wellness treatment that uses gentle massage techniques and stimulation of specific acupressure points on the face, scalp, and neck.
